description: To cover the fundamentals of neural networks as well as advanced topics such as recurrent neural networks, LSTM cells and convolutional neural networks, and the basic applications of deep learning.

syllabus.title: Introduction
syllabus.body: History of deep learning, biological neuron, McCulloch–Pitts unit and thresholding logic, linear perceptron, perceptron learning algorithm, linear separability, convergence theorem for perceptron learning algorithm.

syllabus.title: Feedforward and Deep Networks
syllabus.body: Multilayer perceptron, gradient descent, backpropagation, empirical risk minimization, regularization, autoencoders, difficulty of training deep neural networks, greedy layerwise training.

syllabus.title: Optimization and Recurrent Networks
syllabus.body: Newer optimization methods (Adagrad, Adadelta, RMSprop, Adam, NAG), saddle point problem, regularization methods (dropout, drop connect, batch normalization); Recurrent Neural Networks: backpropagation through time, LSTM, GRU, bidirectional LSTMs/RNNs.

syllabus.title: Convolutional and Generative Models
syllabus.body: CNN architectures: LeNet, AlexNet, ZF-Net, VGGNet, visualizing CNNs, guided backpropagation, Deep Dream, Deep Art; generative models: Restricted Boltzmann Machines, MCMC and Gibbs sampling, Deep Boltzmann Machines.

syllabus.title: Recent Trends
syllabus.body: Variational autoencoders, generative adversarial networks, multi-task and multi-view deep learning, applications in image classification, vision and NLP.

outcomes: Basic and advanced concepts of deep learning.
textbooks: Ian J. Goodfellow, Bengio Yoshua, and Aaron Courville, Deep Learning, MIT Press.
Charu C. Aggarwal, Neural Networks and Deep Learning: A Textbook, Springer Nature, 2018.
